group_order: group 0 = highest energy (edges ascend, as coeffs.npz)

arrays.sig_damage: [cell, G] damage energy (MT 444) per unit flux, eV/cm; sum_g track_g * sig_damage_g = eV of damage energy per source neutron in the cell
arrays.sig_he: [cell, G] He-4 production (MT 207, (n,Xa)) per unit flux, 1/cm; sum_g track_g * sig_he_g = He atoms per source neutron
arrays.Ed_eV: [cell] NRT displacement energy, 0 = no dpa for this cell
